walkthrough.title: Get started with Square Cloud
walkthrough.description: Deploy, run and watch your applications without leaving VS Code, one small step at a time.
walkthrough.connect.title: Connect your account
walkthrough.connect.description:
Connecting lets this editor manage Square Cloud for you.
Click **Connect account**, paste the 8-character code from VS Code into the page that opens in your browser, and approve. The authorization is kept in your system keychain, lasts 90 days and can be revoked anytime.
[Connect account](command:squarecloud.setApiKey)
walkthrough.connect.alt: Connecting your account: VS Code shows a code, you paste it in the browser and approve, and your authorization is stored securely.
walkthrough.config.title: Describe your application in squarecloud.app
walkthrough.config.description:
Every application has a **squarecloud.app** file in its root folder. It tells Square Cloud how to run it: the main file, how much memory to reserve, the runtime and, for websites, a subdomain.
Open one and this extension helps while you type: autocomplete for every field (Ctrl+Space), instant validation with clear messages, and quick fixes for invalid values.
[Open the config file reference](https://docs.squarecloud.app/getting-started/config-file)
walkthrough.config.alt: Editing the squarecloud.app config file with autocomplete suggestions.
walkthrough.upload.title: Upload your application
walkthrough.upload.description:
**Upload** zips your project folder (skipping what squarecloud.ignore lists), sends it to Square Cloud and starts it.
Already online? **Commit** sends updated files to an existing application and keeps its ID and address.
[Upload an application](command:squarecloud.uploadApplication)
[Commit files](command:squarecloud.commitEntry)
walkthrough.upload.alt: Your project is zipped and uploaded to Square Cloud, where it starts running.
walkthrough.manage.title: Start, stop and restart
walkthrough.manage.description:
The Square Cloud sidebar lists your applications, each with a status badge: Online, Offline, or amber while a start, stop or restart is in progress. Hover over a card to start, stop or restart it, click it for details, and right-click it (or use ⋯) for everything else, like environment variables.
[Open the sidebar](command:workbench.view.extension.squarecloud-container)
[Restart an application](command:squarecloud.restartEntry)
[Edit environment variables](command:squarecloud.envsEntry)
walkthrough.manage.alt: Start, stop and restart applications from the sidebar and watch their status change.
walkthrough.logs.title: Follow logs and metrics
walkthrough.logs.description:
Logs are what your application prints. **Show logs** fetches the latest lines, and the **realtime stream** keeps following new ones as they arrive. **24h metrics** show CPU, memory and network over the last day (applications with 512 MB or more).
[Show logs](command:squarecloud.logsEntry)
[Toggle realtime stream](command:squarecloud.realtimeEntry)
[Show 24h metrics](command:squarecloud.metricsEntry)
walkthrough.logs.alt: Realtime logs streaming alongside live CPU and memory charts.
walkthrough.snapshots.title: Back up with snapshots
walkthrough.snapshots.description:
A snapshot is a backup of your application's files. Download one before a risky change; if something breaks, restore the application to an earlier snapshot.
[Download a snapshot](command:squarecloud.snapshotEntry)
[Restore a snapshot](command:squarecloud.snapshotRestoreEntry)
walkthrough.snapshots.alt: Choosing a snapshot from the timeline and restoring your application to it.
walkthrough.databases.title: Create a database
walkthrough.databases.description:
Square Cloud hosts managed MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Redis databases with encrypted (TLS) connections. Create one here and its connection URL is copied for you; then download its TLS certificate so your application can connect.
[Create a database](command:squarecloud.createDatabase)
[Download the TLS certificate](command:squarecloud.downloadDatabaseCertificate)
walkthrough.databases.alt: Managed databases with a TLS certificate and credentials.
walkthrough.workspaces.title: Work as a team
walkthrough.workspaces.description:
A workspace is a shared space where teammates manage the same applications, each with their own role. Create one for your team, or copy your invite code and send it to a workspace owner so they can add you.
[Create a workspace](command:squarecloud.createWorkspace)
[Copy my invite code](command:squarecloud.generateInviteCode)
walkthrough.workspaces.alt: Team members joining a workspace around a shared application, each with a role.
walkthrough.github.title: Deploy on every git push
walkthrough.github.description:
Link an application to a GitHub repository and branch, and every push to that branch deploys it automatically, no upload needed. Install the Square Cloud GitHub App from the dashboard first.
[Link a GitHub repository](command:squarecloud.linkGithubAppEntry)
walkthrough.github.alt: A git push triggers a webhook deploy: pending, clone, commit, restarting, success.
walkthrough.network.title: Understand your traffic
walkthrough.network.description:
Websites get edge analytics: request logs, errors and response times, plus a cache purge for when you publish changes. Available for applications with a domain.
[Edge logs](command:squarecloud.networkLogsEntry)
[Edge performance](command:squarecloud.networkPerformanceEntry)
[Purge edge cache](command:squarecloud.purgeCacheEntry)
walkthrough.network.alt: Edge analytics: incoming requests around the globe, traffic charts and cache purge.

scopes.title: What will VS Code be able to do?
scopes.account: See your name, email and plan.
scopes.appsRead: See your applications, their status, logs and metrics.
scopes.appsControl: Start, stop and restart your applications.
scopes.appsDeploy: Upload new applications and send files to existing ones.
scopes.appsWrite: Change application settings and delete applications, only when you ask.
scopes.snapshots: Download snapshots (backups) and restore an application to one.
scopes.databases: See, create, start, stop and delete your databases.
scopes.databaseCredentials: Download database TLS certificates and credentials.
scopes.workspaces: Create, leave and delete workspaces, and invite people to them.
scopes.footer: It never sees your password. The authorization lasts 90 days, and you can revoke it anytime in My Account → Authentication.
